prompt: Migrate this three-module pipeline to typed tokens, in order. (1) tokenize in tokens.ts must return Token objects {kind: "word" | "number", value: string} instead of plain strings, classifying a token as a number when it matches an optionally signed integer or decimal. (2) buildRecord in build.ts must consume Token[] and decide by `kind`, not by re-testing the text: the record's name is the first word token's value and its values are the number tokens in order. (3) report in report.ts must keep producing "<name>: <sum> over <count>" through the migrated pipeline. Keep the three exported names. Add tests covering each step and run them. Use only built-in Bun/Node libraries; no package installation is needed.
notes: Step 3's end-to-end check passes even when step 1's interface is wrong; only c1 catches that.
